answer: Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, idle agents bleed standing. Reaching the ivory of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. A cipher of per-task receipts records who did what, and the garden of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
